#### List:

- Upper airway
- Lower airway
- Other

#### Upper airway:

+---------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Narrow upper airways:**             | - ↑ Resistance. Provides auto-PEEP                              |
|                                       | - Guedel airway useful during mask ventilation                  |
| - Narrow nasal passages               |                                                                 |
| - Large tongue                        |                                                                 |
| - Narrow pharynx                      |                                                                 |
+---------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Obligate nose breather because of** | - Any nasal obstruction = dangerous                             |
|                                       |                                                                 |
| - Large tongue                        |                                                                 |
| - High laryngeal inlet (C3-4 cf. C6)  |                                                                 |
+---------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Prominent occiput:**                | - Tendency for flexion → obstruction                            |
|                                       | - Folded towel under shoulders for bag-mask vent and intubation |
+---------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Lower airways:

+-------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Narrower lower airways**                                  | - Any further obstruction = dangerous\                        |
|                                                             |   \                                                           |
| - Includes larynx, trachea and bronchi\                     | - Risk of subglottic stenosis with prolonged intubation       |
|   Resistance 25cmH2O/L/s on day 2                           |                                                               |
| - Note narrowest point cricoid ring (cf. glottis in adults) |                                                               |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| - Epiglottis long, U shape, floppy                          | - Can be bypassed using straight bladed laryngoscope (Miller) |
|                                                             | - Risk of glottic obstruction by misplaced LMA                |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| - Laryngeal inlet is high C3-4 and anterior                 | - Different intubation mechanics                              |
| - Larynx                                                    |                                                               |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| - Short trachea                                             | - Risk of endobronchial intubation during neck flexion        |
|                                                             | - Risk of accidental extubation during neck extension         |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Other:

+---------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Risk of oxygen toxicity   | - Bronchopulmonary dysplasia                                                                                              |
|                           | - (Other: retinopathy of prematurity, necrotising enterocolitis)                                                          |
+---------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Non-respiratory functions | - Innate immunity e.g. mucocilicary escalator present in neonate and adult                                                |
|                           | - Adaptive immunity: passive (from breast milk) vs endogenous. No endogenous IgG or IgA in neonatal alveolar lining fluid |
+---------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
